pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Stone**.

Unravel Thread to string, spin yarn, tie a Binding Knot, raise a Loomframe. The Tension Barrel makes clay; clay makes porcelain; porcelain carries lava.

Then the sieve — a tool inside Recover, not the name of it. Iron mesh is the target: Strand Filament starts there. Finish the **Stone Knot** and seat Stone.

pages.title: Recover
pages.text: The Grit-singers named every shard by its echo. Recover is pulling the fallen world back into matter.
